Our Story

Calle Fuego started with a single pot, a handful of dried chiles, and a recipe rooted deep in Mexican tradition.

Every jar we make is small-batch, hand-crafted, and built around the deep, smoky flavors of real dried peppers — marinated the right way, in olive oil, with time and care.

No shortcuts. No fillers. Just heat you can taste.
